summary: Finance user submitted credentials on a fake document-sharing page; attacker created a hidden mailbox forwarding rule.
evidence: Phishing email from lookalike domain to 14 recipients; 3 clicked, 1 submitted credentials
Login to fin.a mailbox from a hosting-provider IP 12 minutes after submission
Inbox rule forwarding invoices to an external address
investigation: Extracted URLs and sender domain; both flagged malicious by threat intel
Reviewed authentication and mailbox activity for the 3 clickers; only one compromised
actions_taken: Blocked sender domain and phishing URL
Revoked sessions for the compromised user
User notified by phone rather than email
outcome: Contained. No invoice data left after the rule was removed.
analyst_feedback: Checking mailbox rules early mattered. Notifying the user by phone avoided tipping off the attacker.
lessons_learned: For credential-phishing, check for mailbox rules/forwarding as persistence
Notify affected users out-of-band, not by email
detection_gaps: No alert on new external forwarding rules
